generations.conceptPrompt: A 1989 village moonshine still, home-made and illicit: a big pot on a brick firebox, a pipe from the lid to a coil in a cooling barrel, all assembled from farm and factory scrap. A cut steel oil drum as the boiler with a welded lid and a pipe, a coil of copper tubing in a second galvanised drum, a small iron firebox. Single object, orthographic-style three-quarter product shot from slightly above, the whole object in frame, plain flat light grey background, soft even studio light, no hands, no stand, no text, no logos, no watermark.
